name: SC-001: Successful Login Redirects to Inventory
objective: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the Login button, and verify the Products heading is visible.
healed_from: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, and verify the text Products is visible on the page.

name: SC-002: Cart Badge Updates on Add to Cart
objective: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the Add to cart button for Sauce Labs Backpack, and verify the cart badge shows 1.
healed_from: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the Add to cart button for Sauce Labs Backpack on the products page, and verify the shopping cart badge displays 1.

name: SC-003: Product Name Opens Detail Page
objective: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the Add to cart button for Sauce Labs Backpack, and verify the cart icon badge shows 1.
healed_from: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, click the Add to cart button for Sauce Labs Backpack, and verify the cart badge shows 1.

name: SC-004: Cart Page Lists Added Items

healed_from: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, add the Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart, and verify the cart badge shows 1.

healed_from: Login to https://www.saucedemo.com/ as standard_user with password secret_sauce, select Price (low to high) from the sort dropdown, and verify the price $7.99 is visible.
